name: lx-ui
description: 面向 React PC 中后台的 lx-ui 组件库基础工程

scripts.build: npm run check && npm run build:lib && npm run build:docs
scripts.build:lib: father build && node scripts/build-stable-css-modules.mjs && node scripts/test-stable-css-modules.mjs && node scripts/check-cjs-consumer.mjs
scripts.build:docs: npm run patch:dumi && dumi build && npm run check:docs-export
scripts.build:docs:empty-skeleton: npm run patch:dumi && node scripts/build-empty-skeleton-docs.mjs && node scripts/check-docs-export.mjs .codex/empty-skeleton-docs-dist --required-set=empty-skeleton
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:docs && npm run lint && npm run test
scripts.test:browser:list:preview: npm run build:docs:list-preview && playwright test tests/browser/list-demo.spec.ts --config=playwright.list-dev.config.ts
scripts.build:docs:statistic-preview: npm run patch:dumi && node scripts/build-statistic-docs-preview.mjs && node scripts/check-docs-export.mjs .codex/statistic-docs-dist --required-page=components/data-display/statistic/index.html
scripts.test:browser:statistic:preview: npm run build:docs:statistic-preview && playwright test tests/browser/statistic-demo.spec.ts --config=playwright.statistic-preview.config.ts
scripts.build:docs:avatar-preview: npm run patch:dumi && node scripts/build-avatar-docs-preview.mjs && node scripts/check-docs-export.mjs .codex/avatar-docs-dist --required-page=components/data-display/avatar/index.html
scripts.test:browser:webkit: playwright test tests/browser/webkit-smoke.spec.ts tests/browser/input-demo.spec.ts tests/browser/badge-demo.spec.ts tests/browser/descriptions-demo.spec.ts tests/browser/statistic-demo.spec.ts --project=webkit
scripts.test:browser:all: npm run test:browser && npm run test:browser:edge && npm run test:browser:webkit
